description: Useful before an AI-built app on Vercel and Supabase launches or is handed off. Runs the local `viberaven check` (no login, no API key, no telemetry), which reads the repository for launch gaps (missing RLS in migrations, leaked secrets, unbounded queries, unsigned webhooks) and writes a prioritized task list to .viberaven/agent-tasklist.md plus a verdict to .viberaven/gate-result.json. This is advice, not a gate: the user decides when to ship. It reads repo files and does not query the live database.

cwd.description: Project root. Defaults to the MCP server cwd.

name: viberaven_check_readiness
